modular-av-audio-mixer.title: Audio mixer

menu.name: Audio mixer
menu.label: Open the audio mixer
menu.hint: Which effects run on your voice, in which order, and how loud.

modular-av-audio-mixer.empty: Effects are modules of their own, and none is enabled in this world. Noise cancellation, reverb, echo and EQ can be turned on from the Modular A/V modules window.

placeHints.pre-gate: The gate hears the result. For noise cancellation, EQ, compression.
placeHints.post-gate: Replaces your voice. For a radio, a pitch shift, a demon.
placeHints.send: Added beside your voice. For reverb and echo: they ring on after the gate closes.

modular-av-audio-mixer.gateHint: Opens when you speak in voice activity mode. Effects before it change what it hears.
modular-av-audio-mixer.channelHint: How much of your voice goes out dry, beside what the sends add.
modular-av-audio-mixer.offHint: Switch it on to change its settings.
modular-av-audio-mixer.keysHint: Arrows move between cards. Space switches a card, Enter opens its settings, Alt and arrows move it, Delete removes it, L goes to its level.

status.failed: Failed. You are heard without it.
status.unavailable: Waiting: this call's server doesn't offer it

warnings.tail-before-gate: {effect} rings on ahead of the voice gate: it holds the gate open, then the gate cuts it off.
warnings.doubled-voice: {effect} is on a send, so your voice is heard twice: with it and without it.
warnings.noise-after-gate: {effect} runs after the voice gate, so the gate still hears the noise.
warnings.channel-without-send: Channel stays at 100% until a send is running to carry it.
warnings.channel-zero-click: This browser can't turn your voice fully off cleanly: the start of a word may be clipped.

modular-av-audio-mixer.cutTails: Cut reverb and delay when my microphone closes

voiceTest.hint: Records a few seconds of your voice with every effect, then plays it back. Mute yourself first if the table shouldn't hear you.
voiceTest.no-microphone: It needs a microphone in the call.

presets.title: Presets
presets.name: Name for a new preset
presets.confirm: Delete the preset "{name}"? This can't be undone.
presets.unsupported: Skipped, not available in this browser: {effects}.

errors.full: You have as many presets as can be saved. Delete one first.

table.unknown: Also runs, not in this world: {effects}.

layers.title: Change the table's voices
layers.hint: Lays one of your presets over a player's setup. What it turns on replaces theirs for as long as it lasts, and ending it gives them their own back.
layers.noPresets: Save a preset on your own voice first: that is what gets laid over theirs.
layers.keepOut: Keep the GM out of my voice
layers.notice: Your GM changed your voice: {label}. You can refuse it in the audio mixer.

states.partly: Your GM changed your voice: {label}. Part of it can't run here.
states.kept-out: You keep your GM out of your voice: {label}.

modular-av-audio-mixer.loadFailed: The audio mixer couldn't load. Reload the page and try again.
